color.note: Monochrome first. Ink carries hierarchy; accent blue marks focus and selection; status hues appear only with an icon or word.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App ground and the detail pane. The quietest surface; content sits directly on it.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Sidebar and list-pane ground. One step off bg so panes separate without heavy borders.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised objects: field groups, popovers, menus, toasts, the search button.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Neutral fills: tags, Kbd keys, monogram tiles, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on rows, ghost buttons and fills.

tokens.name: fill-active
tokens.usage: Selected row, pressed controls, the active segment's track.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: pane dividers, card edges, row separators.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, secondary-button and search-field borders.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Control border on hover.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every ground and surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, field labels, inactive nav. On every ground, surface and fill.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Metadata, placeholders, counts, timestamps. Holds 4.5:1 on bg, bg-subtle, surface and fill.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only. Exempt from contrast; never for information.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Monochrome by design: the loudest control is ink, not color.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a primary fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Focus rings, links, info badges, digits in a revealed password. Used sparingly; never a large fill.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Link and accent hover.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent text: info badges, the current-space dot halo.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Healthy state: strong password, 2FA on, synced. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind success text in badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention: reused or aging password, expiring card. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warning text in badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and failures: wrong password, breached secret, delete.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text in badges and the error line.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring color: 2px solid outline at 2px offset on every focusable control. An alias of accent.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the command menu.

tokens.name: mark-tile
tokens.usage: The app-icon tile behind the bird mark. Stays dark in both themes, as the icon does.

tokens.name: mark-ink
tokens.usage: The bird itself on mark-tile.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one headline on the lock screen and empty states. Once per screen.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Item name in the detail pane; dialog titles.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Page titles inside a pane: Settings, Watchtower.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Recovery codes live in their own item.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Row titles, button labels at md and lg, field values that must stand out.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Row subtitles, field labels, sidebar items.

styles.name: small-medium
styles.usage: Sidebar active item, sm buttons, badges at md.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Sidebar section labels. Always uppercase (text-transform), in text-tertiary.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Secrets, keys, paths, hashes, anything a person may compare character by character.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Cipher and KDF details, footers, Kbd keys.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: One-time codes, grouped in threes with a thin space.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Density comes from 28 to 32px rows and 8px gaps; air comes from 24 to 48px pane padding.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Icon to label nudges; Kbd key gaps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact controls; badge icon gap.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside buttons and nav items; inset of selected rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap between related controls; sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding; gap between a tile and its text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field padding; gap between groups inside a pane.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Pane header side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between detail sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major detail sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Lock screen stack gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Detail pane side padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top padding above the lock stack.

radius.note: Soft, not round. Controls 6 to 8px, containers 12px, the app icon 22%.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Kbd keys and icon buttons at xs.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons at sm, nav items, icon buttons, the unlock arrow.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons at md and lg, inputs, list rows, monogram tiles at md.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Field groups, popovers, toasts, monogram tiles at lg.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command menu.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The app-icon tile: a continuous squircle approximation at any size.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, switches, dots, the TOTP ring.

shadow.note: Light theme lifts with soft shadow; dark theme lifts with a 1px white edge, since shadows vanish on near-black.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, inputs, the search field.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Field groups and the selected segment.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the command menu, the app-icon tile on the lock screen.

tokens.name: shadow-highlight
tokens.usage: Top-edge highlight on primary buttons and the app-icon tile.

size.note: Fixed dimensions the layout is built on.

tokens.name: control-xs
tokens.usage: Icon buttons inside fields and rows.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Sidebar items, sm buttons, pane-header actions.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs, the search field.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Lock screen field and buttons; primary actions in dialogs.

tokens.name: titlebar
tokens.usage: Window title bar and pane headers; traffic lights sit centered in it.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar width.

tokens.name: list-pane
tokens.usage: Item list width.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Item row height in the list.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in badges and captions.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in empty states and the lock field.
